features.title: Your playlists, together
features.description: Connect with Xtream Codes, an M3U link or a local playlist file. Keep multiple profiles on your device.

features.title: A full TV guide
features.description: Load XMLTV schedules, search programmes and use catch-up when your provider supports it.

features.title: Movies and series
features.description: Browse your provider’s library, choose seasons and continue with the next episode.

features.title: Favorites and history
features.description: Save channels, resume watching and clear recents without deleting your profiles.

features.title: Playback your way
features.description: Adjust playback over the video, choose supported player options and set a sleep timer.

features.title: Take your settings with you
features.description: Export and import an encrypted backup of profiles and preferences. Use family controls for protected categories.

changes: GlowTV branding, launcher icons, Inter typography and a leaf-green design system.
Dark Android surfaces, native pill navigation, checked filters and an Add playlist sheet.
Fixed Android 13–15 Back navigation from details and settings, including after reopening the app.
Repeated identical player updates keep the existing VLC decoder alive instead of restarting playback.
